title: Cosmic Web Atlas: an interactive 3D model of the large-scale structure of the universe
description:
An interactive 3D model of the large-scale structure of the universe, from the Local Group out to the cosmic microwave background, in a single HTML file (Three.js). Live version: pandakingpunc.github.io/cosmic-web-atlas.

The atlas places the 43,482 galaxies of the 2MASS Redshift Survey (Huchra et al. 2012) in supergalactic coordinates from their redshifts; the catalog is not bundled, the browser downloads it from CDS VizieR at run time. A 600,043-object sample of DESI Data Release 1 (DESI Collaboration et al. 2026; bright, luminous red and emission-line galaxies and quasars out to z = 3.5) is bundled under CC BY 4.0 and extends the real web into the deep universe. Several hundred clusters, superclusters, walls, voids, quasars, protoclusters and record-distance galaxies are placed at their literature positions, and unmapped regions (including the Zone of Avoidance) are filled with a Voronoi foam model whose texture is realistic but whose individual positions are invented.

Features: five scales from the Local Group to the observable universe, a guided tour and a records tour, search, an atlas index filterable by kind, an info card (distance, redshift, light travel time, age of the universe then, recession velocity, sky and galactic coordinates, nearest neighbors), a distance-measuring tool, a look-back-time shell, Laniakea flow lines, the Local Group's motion relative to the CMB, and English/Turkish interfaces. Cosmology: H0 = 70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m = 0.3; distances are comoving.
